question: Choose the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**based**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence refers to the location of the organization Working Dogs for Conservation.
 
• The word "based" is used to indicate the main location of an organization or person's operations.
 
• Other options like "surviving", "living", and "rested" do not correctly imply the idea of the main location of an organization.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Sniffer dog Tucker uses his__ nose to help researchers find out why a killer whale population off the northwest coast of the United States is __on__ the decline. He searches for whale faeces floating on the surface of the water, which are then collected for examination. He is one of the elite team members of detection dogs used by scientists studying a __number__ of species including right whales and killer whales. Conservation canines are fast becoming indispensable tools for biologists according to Aimee Hurt, associate director and co-founder of Working Dogs for Conservation, __based__ in Three Forks, Montana. Over the last few years, though, so many new conservation dog projects have sprung up that Hurt can no **_________**keep track of them all. Her organisation’s dogs and their handlers are fully booked to assist field researchers into 2012.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Surviving (जीवित): This means continuing to live or exist, especially in spite of danger or hardship, which does not fit the context of location.
 
• Living (रहना): This means having life or being alive, which is related to existence, not specifically location.
 
• Rested (आराम किया हुआ): This means having had rest or being refreshed, which does not imply the main location of activities.
